# Trigger reference

<!-- Generated by `gdl docs triggers`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every trigger is called as `name(x, y, ...)` and returns an object handle.
Required arguments come first, in the order shown; optional ones follow and are
easiest to give **by name**:

```
pickup(300, 15, 1, 5)                         // item 1 += 5
pickup(300, 15, 1, 2, mode = PICKUP_MULTIPLY) // item 1 *= 2
move(0, 45, 3, 0, 60, 2, easing = EASE_IN_OUT, easing_rate = 1.5)
```

Every trigger also accepts these options by name: `spawn_triggered`, `touch_triggered`, `multi_triggered`.

Need one that isn't here? `trigger(id, x, y)` makes any trigger and `set(h, key, value)` fills in properties (see `P_*` and `ID_*` constants).

45 triggers are wrapped.

## move

Move a group by an offset. Object id `901`.

```
move(x, y, target, dx, dy, secs, [easing], [easing_rate], [lock_player_x], [lock_player_y])
```

| argument | key | | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | 51 | number | group to move |
| `dx` | 28 | number | x offset in units (30 = 1 block) |
| `dy` | 29 | number | y offset in units |
| `secs` | 10 | number | duration in seconds |
| `easing` | 30 | number, optional | easing curve, one of the EASE_* constants |
| `easing_rate` | 85 | number, optional | easing rate (the game's default is 2) |
| `lock_player_x` | 58 | true/false, optional | follow the player's x movement |
| `lock_player_y` | 59 | true/false, optional | follow the player's y movement |

## rotate

Rotate a group around a center group. Object id `1346`.

```
rotate(x, y, target, center, degrees, secs, [easing], [easing_rate], [times360], [lock_rotation])
```

| argument | key | | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | 51 | number | group to rotate |
| `center` | 71 | number | center group (0 = own center) |
| `degrees` | 68 | number | degrees to rotate |
| `secs` | 10 | number | duration in seconds |
| `easing` | 30 | number, optional | easing curve, one of the EASE_* constants |
| `easing_rate` | 85 | number, optional | easing rate (the game's default is 2) |
| `times360` | 69 | number, optional | extra full turns |
| `lock_rotation` | 70 | true/false, optional | lock object rotation |

| `relative_scale` | 577 | true/false, optional | scale relative to the current scale |

| `remap` | 442 | text, optional | remap string, e.g. "1.2.3.4" remaps group 1 to 2 and 3 to 4 |

| `delay_var` | 556 | number, optional | random +/- delay variation |
| `no_preview` | 102 | true/false, optional | disable editor preview |

## gradient

Define a gradient between four group vertices. Object id `2903`.

```
gradient(x, y, gradient_id, up, down, left, right, [layer], [blending], [vertex_mode], [disable], [preview_opacity], [disable_all])
```

| argument | key | | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gradient_id` | 209 | number | gradient id |
| `up` | 203 | number | group of the up (bottom-left in vertex mode) vertex |
| `down` | 204 | number | group of the down (bottom-right) vertex |
| `left` | 205 | number | group of the left (top-left) vertex |
| `right` | 206 | number | group of the right (top-right) vertex |
| `layer` | 202 | number, optional | LAYER_* constant (default LAYER_MG) |
| `blending` | 174 | number, optional | BLEND_* constant |
| `vertex_mode` | 207 | true/false, optional | use vertex mode |
| `disable` | 208 | true/false, optional | disable this gradient |
| `preview_opacity` | 456 | number, optional | editor preview opacity 0-1 |
| `disable_all` | 508 | true/false, optional | disable all gradients |

## camera_static

Lock the camera to a group. Object id `1914`.

```

```

| argument | key | | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | 71 | number | group to focus on |
| `secs` | 10 | number | duration in seconds |
| `easing` | 30 | number, optional | easing curve, one of the EASE_* constants |
| `easing_rate` | 85 | number, optional | easing rate (the game's default is 2) |
| `follow` | 212 | true/false, optional | follow the group |
| `follow_easing` | 213 | number, optional | follow easing |
| `exit_instant` | 465 | true/false, optional | exit instantly |
| `exit_static` | 110 | true/false, optional | exit static |

## item_edit

Compute a value into an item (counter or timer). Object id `3619`.

```
item_edit(x, y, target, op, modifier, [item1], [item2], [item_op], [mod_op], [type1], [type2], [target_type], [round1], [round2], [sign1], [sign2])
```

| argument | key | | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | 51 | number | item to write to |
| `op` | 480 | number | how to write: OP_SET, OP_ADD, OP_SUB, OP_MUL or OP_DIV |
| `modifier` | 479 | number | number combined with the operands |
| `item1` | 80 | number, optional | first operand item |
| `item2` | 95 | number, optional | second operand item |
| `item_op` | 481 | number, optional | operator between the two items (OP_ADD...) |
| `mod_op` | 482 | number, optional | OP_MUL (default) or OP_DIV for the modifier |
| `type1` | 476 | number, optional | ITEM_COUNTER, ITEM_TIMER, ITEM_POINTS, ITEM_TIME or ITEM_ATTEMPTS |
| `type2` | 477 | number, optional | type of item2 |
| `target_type` | 478 | number, optional | type of the target item |
| `round1` | 485 | number, optional | ROUND_* applied to the operand result |
| `round2` | 486 | number, optional | ROUND_* applied to the final result |
| `sign1` | 578 | number, optional | SIGN_* applied to the operand result |
| `sign2` | 579 | number, optional | SIGN_* applied to the final result |

## item_compare

Spawn one of two groups depending on a comparison. Object id `3620`.

```
item_compare(x, y, item1, item2, compare, true_group, false_group, [mod1], [mod2], [tolerance], [type1], [type2], [round1], [round2], [sign1], [sign2])
```

| argument | key | | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `item1` | 80 | number | left item |
| `item2` | 95 | number | right item |
| `compare` | 482 | number | CMP_EQ, CMP_GT, CMP_GTE, CMP_LT or CMP_LTE |
| `true_group` | 51 | number | group spawned when true (0 = none) |
| `false_group` | 71 | number | group spawned when false (0 = none) |
| `mod1` | 479 | number, optional | multiplier for item1 |
| `mod2` | 483 | number, optional | multiplier for item2 |
| `tolerance` | 484 | number, optional | tolerance |
| `type1` | 476 | number, optional | ITEM_* type of item1 (default counter) |
| `type2` | 477 | number, optional | ITEM_* type of item2 (default counter) |
| `round1` | 485 | number, optional | ROUND_* for the left side |
| `round2` | 486 | number, optional | ROUND_* for the right side |
| `sign1` | 578 | number, optional | SIGN_* for the left side |
| `sign2` | 579 | number, optional | SIGN_* for the right side |

## random

Spawn one of two groups by chance. Object id `1912`.

```
random(x, y, chance, group_a, group_b)
```

| argument | key | | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chance` | 10 | number | percent chance of group_a (0-100) |
| `group_a` | 51 | number | group on success |
| `group_b` | 71 | number | group otherwise |

## adv_random

Spawn one of many groups by weight. Object id `2068`.

```
adv_random(x, y, groups)
```

| argument | key | | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `groups` | 152 | text | "group.weight.group.weight...", e.g. "1.5.2.3" |

## on_death

Toggle a group when the player dies. Object id `1812`.

```
on_death(x, y, target, activate)
```

| argument | key | | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | 51 | number | group |
| `activate` | 56 | true/false | true = activate |

## collision

Toggle a group when two collision blocks touch. Object id `1815`.

```
collision(x, y, block_a, block_b, target, activate, [on_exit], [p1], [p2], [any_player])
```

| argument | key | | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `block_a` | 80 | number | first collision block id |
| `block_b` | 95 | number | second collision block id |
| `target` | 51 | number | group |
| `activate` | 56 | true/false | true = activate |
| `on_exit` | 93 | true/false, optional | trigger on exit |
| `p1` | 138 | true/false, optional | player 1 |
| `p2` | 200 | true/false, optional | player 2 |
| `any_player` | 201 | true/false, optional | either player |

## instant_collision

Spawn a group depending on whether blocks touch. Object id `3609`.

```
instant_collision(x, y, block_a, block_b, true_group, false_group, [p1], [p2], [any_player])
```

| argument | key | | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `block_a` | 80 | number | first collision block id |
| `block_b` | 95 | number | second collision block id |
| `true_group` | 51 | number | group when colliding |
| `false_group` | 71 | number | group when not |
| `p1` | 138 | true/false, optional | player 1 |
| `p2` | 200 | true/false, optional | player 2 |
| `any_player` | 201 | true/false, optional | either player |

## gravity

Change gravity. Object id `2066`.

```
gravity(x, y, gravity, [p1], [p2], [target_player])
```

| argument | key | | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gravity` | 148 | number | gravity multiplier |
| `p1` | 138 | true/false, optional | player 1 |
| `p2` | 200 | true/false, optional | player 2 |
| `target_player` | 201 | true/false, optional | target player |

## timewarp

Change game speed. Object id `1935`.

```
timewarp(x, y, scale)
```

| argument | key | | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scale` | 120 | number | time scale (1 = normal) |

## bg_speed

Change background scroll speed. Object id `3606`.

```
bg_speed(x, y, mod_x, mod_y)
```

| argument | key | | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mod_x` | 143 | number | x multiplier |
| `mod_y` | 144 | number | y multiplier |

## level_end

End the level. Object id `3600`.

```
level_end(x, y, [spawn_group], [target_pos], [no_effects], [instant], [no_sfx])
```

| argument | key | | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `spawn_group` | 51 | number, optional | group to spawn on end |
| `target_pos` | 71 | number, optional | end position group |
| `no_effects` | 460 | true/false, optional | no end effects |
| `instant` | 487 | true/false, optional | instant |
| `no_sfx` | 461 | true/false, optional | no end sound |

## show_player

Show the player. Object id `1613`.

```
show_player(x, y)
```


## hide_player

```
hide_player(x, y)
```

## bg_effect_off

```
bg_effect_off(x, y)
```


## reverse_gameplay

Reverse gameplay direction. Object id `1917`.

```

```
